fields.statement: At 90b5eedf: go test -trimpath ./internal/doclinks/... ok. make self-check reports no docs-command (or docs) finding; check.go runs docsCommands unconditionally. Its only fails are outside this leaf: a fold error in the run's chore evidence entry 01M73DBN12V9QWEYY25C1JVHGG (from 06285a98), whose after names an entry not committed in the leaf checkout, and stale .rhiza/rendered for new actor records, which the run renders at close-out. grep -nE '\{"writes|"quotes"' docs/concepts/why.md finds nothing. The diff replaces the apply JSON with rhiza add decision --field ... and rhiza link export-csv decided-by csv-streaming. The Source section asks the agent to use the rhiza-scrub skill, which writes the file and runs rhiza source add, and names --raw, --raw-sha256 and --raw-session in prose. The prose is plain and in the owner's voice. The commit adds only the builder's actor record under .rhiza. Owner approval is left to the run's sign-off.
